project_type: NestJS 10 (TypeScript) backend + React Native 0.88 / Expo 58 (TypeScript) Android client, with a Prisma 5 + PostgreSQL data layer
build_system: Backend: npm scripts via @nestjs/cli (`nest build` = tsc). Android: Expo + plain tsc for typecheck. No monorepo — backend/ and android/ are separate npm projects with their own node_modules. Quirk: there is NO `include`/`exclude` in backend tsconfig.json, so tsc compiles EVERY .ts file under backend/src — dead files with broken imports WILL fail the build (the dead src/common/app.module.ts currently breaks `npm run build`).
test_framework: None. There are no unit tests in the repo (no .spec.ts files). Verification is by compilation only.
build_command: cd f:\Score Koto\backend && npm run build
test_command: cd f:\Score Koto\android && npx tsc --noEmit  (frontend typecheck; no runtime tests exist)
verification_instructions: 1. Backend compiles: cd f:\Score Koto\backend && npm run build  (expect 0 errors). 2. Frontend typechecks: cd f:\Score Koto\android && npx tsc --noEmit  (expect exit 0). 3. Prisma schema valid + client regenerated: cd f:\Score Koto\backend && npx prisma generate (and `npx prisma db push` to apply to the DB if the Postgres container is up via `docker compose up -d`). NOTE: grep checks are NOT verification — always run the real build/typecheck commands.
snapshot_or_generated_files: backend/dist (build output, gitignored — not checked in). Prisma client is generated into node_modules by `npx prisma generate` (not checked in). No snapshot files to commit. After editing prisma/schema.prisma, run `npx prisma generate` (regenerates the client so `prisma.footballMatch` is removed) and `npx prisma db push` (applies the schema to Postgres; needs the DB container up).
environment_constraints: Windows host, bash shell. Backend build (`npm run build`) does NOT need the database or any API key — it is pure tsc compilation. Frontend `npx tsc --noEmit` does NOT need the backend running. `npx prisma db push` DOES need Postgres up (docker compose up -d, port 5433). The backend build is CURRENTLY BROKEN (6 errors from the dead src/common/app.module.ts) — deleting that file is a required fix, not optional. Goal API key is in backend/.env as GOAL_API_KEY; Goal API has no daily quota. The frontend hardcodes the backend LAN IP in android/src/services/api.ts (BASE_URL) and android/src/hooks/useLiveUpdates.ts (SOCKET_URL) — do NOT change these unless asked.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING.md present. From PROGRESS.md: backend URL is a hardcoded LAN IP in the android client; never commit backend/.env. The repo's last commit is a 'broken version' — the build must be made to pass.
key_patterns: NestJS modules: each feature module (Football/Cricket/Health) provides its own PrismaService and imports ProvidersModule; QuotaModule is @Global. Providers normalize external API responses into NormalizedFootballMatch/NormalizedCricketMatch. GoalApiProvider.normalize() maps real Goal API fields: f.id->goalApiId, f.homeTeamName, f.homeTeamFtScore||f.homeTeamScore->homeScore, f.matchStatus (STATUS_MAP)->status, f.matchMinute->elapsed, f.leagueName->competition, f.teamHomeBadge->homeTeamLogo, f.kickoffUtc||f.matchDate->kickoff. The frontend treats every match row as a FootballMatch with an `id` used for React keys, dedupeMatches, sameMatch, and navigation; setting backend `id = goalApiId` keeps all of that working. WebSocket events: 'football:live' and 'cricket:live' emitted by LiveGateway.pushFootballUpdate/pushCricketUpdate.
directory_structure: backend/src/: app.module.ts (root), common/ (prisma.service, quota.service/module), providers/ (goal-api primary + cricket manager; secondary football providers being deleted), football/ (controller, service, module, match-identity), cricket/ (controller, service, module), sync/ (sync.service cron), live/ (live.gateway WebSocket), health/ (controller, module). backend/prisma/schema.prisma. android/src/: services/api.ts (Axios client + typed API fns), screens/ (Home/Live/Fixtures/MatchDetail/etc.), utils/ (featured.ts helpers, matchGrouping.tsx, matchDisplay.ts, homeHelpers.ts), hooks/ (useLiveUpdates.ts WebSocket), navigation/. docs/: ARCHITECTURE.md, API_PROVIDERS.md, DEVELOPMENT.md. Repo root: PROGRESS.md, README.md.
